summary: Bain Capital Private Credit filed an 8-K declaring a regular distribution of $0.1875/share and a special distribution of $0.0300/share for Class I shares, payable July 31, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. It also provided NAV of $25.90/share as of May 31, 2026, portfolio update (88% first lien senior secured debt, 92% floating rate), and disclosed a tender offer that expired June 1, 2026, which repurchased 496,481 shares (1.27% of outstanding) at an undisclosed price. The fund has a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.23x. Watch if special distributions persist or if further tenders are announced.
